question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT dm.name_id, dm.movie_id, m.date_published, m.duration
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
),
director_with_ranks AS (
  SELECT name_id, movie_id, date_published, duration,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published) as rn
  FROM director_movies
),
inter_movie_gaps AS (
  SELECT d1.name_id,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d1.date_published - d2.date_published)) / 86400.0 as gap_days
  FROM director_with_ranks d1
  JOIN director_with_ranks d2 ON d1.name_id = d2.name_id AND d1.rn = d2.rn + 1
),
director_avg_gaps AS (
  SELECT name_id, AVG(gap_days) as avg_gap
  FROM inter_movie_gaps
  GROUP BY name_id
),
director_counts AS (
  SELECT name_id, COUNT(*) as movie_count, SUM(duration) as total_duration
  FROM director_movies
  GROUP BY name_id
),
director_ratings AS (
  SELECT dm.name_id,
    AVG(r.avg_rating) as avg_rating,
    SUM(r.total_votes) as total_votes,
    MIN(r.avg_rating) as min_rating,
    MAX(r.avg_rating) as max_rating
  FROM director_mapping dm
  JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
  GROUP BY dm.name_id
)
SELECT dc.name_id,
  n.name,
  CAST(dc.movie_count AS INTEGER) as movie_count,
  CAST(ROUND(COALESCE(dag.avg_gap, 0)) AS INTEGER) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
  ROUND(COALESCE(dr.avg_rating, 0), 2) as avg_rating,
  CAST(COALESCE(dr.total_votes, 0) AS INTEGER) as total_votes,
  dr.min_rating,
  dr.max_rating,
  CAST(dc.total_duration AS INTEGER) as total_duration
FROM director_counts dc
LEFT JOIN director_avg_gaps dag ON dc.name_id = dag.name_id
LEFT JOIN director_ratings dr ON dc.name_id = dr.name_id
JOIN names n ON dc.name_id = n.id
ORDER BY dc.movie_count DESC, dc.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
